includes.comment: Maven's SUPER POM, read by the model builder for every [maven] dependency. It lives inside maven-model-builder.jar and native-image does not embed jar resources unless told to, so `mez sync` failed with 'The super POM /org/apache/maven/model/pom-4.0.0.xml was not found, please verify the integrity of your Maven installation' AFTER the artifact had downloaded.

The CLI's own logging config, which pins the root logger to ERROR. native-image does not embed it unless told to, so the native binary fell back to logback's DEBUG default and `mez sync` printed 1311 lines of Apache HttpClient wire debug (measured; the JVM build printed 0) around the real output.
